methods.name: Table 14.3.1: treatment-emergent adverse events by system class and preferred term
Table 14.2.1: IGA-CHE treatment success at Week 16 (primary endpoint)
methods.description: IGA-CHE success (PARAMCD "IGACHE") at Week 16 (ADQS AVISITN 16, CRIT1FL "Y"). Intent-to-treat participants without a Week 16 record count as non-responders (MISS counts them). Per TRT01P: N, RESP n and pct, MISS n. For each dose: DIFF est, lcl, ucl in percentage points (Wald: p1 - p0 ± 1.96 √(p1(1-p1)/n1 + p0(1-p0)/n0)) and p from fisher.test() on the 2 × 2 table of responders against placebo.

methods.name: Table 14.2.2: HECSI-75 at Week 16 (key secondary endpoint)
methods.description: HECSI-75 (PARAMCD "HECSI") at Week 16 (ADQS AVISITN 16, CRIT1FL "Y"). Intent-to-treat participants without a Week 16 record count as non-responders (MISS counts them). Per TRT01P: N, RESP n and pct, MISS n. For each dose: DIFF est, lcl, ucl in percentage points (Wald: p1 - p0 ± 1.96 √(p1(1-p1)/n1 + p0(1-p0)/n0)) and p from fisher.test() on the 2 × 2 table of responders against placebo.
